portfolio_margin_enabled.meaning: Portfolio Margin is activated on the Vault's L1 account

usdm_minted_ratio.meaning: USDM minted per USDC against the Vault's USDC (report states 1:1)

auto_borrow_triggered.meaning: HyperLiquid PM auto-borrow has triggered on the Vault's L1 account due to adverse price movement

phantom_surplus_passes_gate.meaning: Accountant-reported surplus (borrow leg invisible) passes Gate 3 distributable cap so settle accepts unbacked yield

assumptions: The keeper's proposed yield equals the reported phantom surplus (surplus computed from on-chain state).
Gate 3 distributable cap is the gate that admits the phantom surplus; Gate 4 also passes in the reported scenario.
Real net assets are unchanged by the auto-borrow; only the reported backing is overstated.

unresolved.description: Report gives surplus only as +X and does not quantify the borrow amount or the distributable cap, so the numeric surplus-vs-cap relation cannot be encoded; a grounded Boolean stands for the gate-pass outcome.

limitations: Only the phantom-surplus-passes-Gate-3 impact is formalized; principal displacement and backing overstatement are separate passes.
Auto-borrow trigger is conditional and not shown as an observed transaction; encoded as a scenario precondition.
No unauthorized-caller condition is claimed; keeper authorization is not part of this claim.
